# Batch / shortcut probe (development patients only; generated by scripts/07_batch_probe.py)

Slides with thumbnails: 82 development patients.

| statistic | rho | p |
|---|---|---|
| mean_r | +0.177 | 0.11 |
| mean_g | +0.161 | 0.15 |
| mean_b | +0.089 | 0.42 |
| od_r | -0.166 | 0.13 |
| od_g | -0.130 | 0.25 |
| od_b | -0.082 | 0.46 |
| saturation | -0.111 | 0.32 |
| brightness | +0.161 | 0.15 |

## 2. Stain statistics alone -> subtype (5-fold CV, agent folds)

- Macro AUROC: **0.474** (for reference: age+sex 0.588, slide ID alone 0.778).

## 3. Mean-pooled FM features -> within-class slide-ID rank (ridge, 5-fold CV R², 200 within-class permutations)

| model | CV R² | permutation p |
|---|---|---|
| phikonv2 | -0.094 | 0.851 |
| phikon | -0.034 | 0.328 |
| lunit_dino | -0.050 | 0.607 |

Figure: `stain_vs_id.png` (strongest within-class stain statistic).

Interpretation guide: probe 2 near the slide-ID AUROC, or a significant probe 3, means batch signal is available to the classifier; mitigations are stain normalisation / colour augmentation at tiling time, or reporting performance within acquisition batches.
